business.name: S S Industries
business.hours: Monday to Saturday, 10 am to 7 pm (to be confirmed)

policies: We are a manufacturer of pins under the brand Suman, in business since 1999.
Prices are per box. Most pins come in 16 to 36 mm and in 70 to 300 g boxes, and the rate depends on size and weight.
Only the owner can give a discount, a special rate or credit.
Delivery dates and transport are confirmed by the owner. We ship by road.
Payment by cash, cheque, DD, card or online transfer.
